crossRefs.note: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.
But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.
Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting…
The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you…
This is what Yahweh, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, Yahweh of Armies, says: “I am the first, and I am the last…
“Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, so that no one passed through you, I will make you an eternal excellency, a…
You, Yahweh, remain forever. Your throne is from generation to generation.
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the…
and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.
Your name, Yahweh, endures forever; your renown, Yahweh, throughout all generations.
God said moreover to Moses, “You shall tell the children of Israel this, ‘Yahweh, the God of your fathers, the God of…

translations.web: But you, Yahweh, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.
translations.bsb: But You, O LORD, sit enthroned forever; Your renown endures to all generations.
translations.kjv: But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
translations.asv: But thou, O Jehovah, wilt abide for ever; And thy memorial name unto all generations.
